screening_decisions.reason: Review article discussing complications of enteral nutrition. Not a randomised controlled trial comparing PEG vs NGT.
Review article describing techniques of enteral feeding. Not a randomised controlled trial.
Systematic review of literature comparing PEG and NGT in head and neck cancer. Not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Retrospective study examining timing of enteral nutrition after esophagectomy. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Opinion piece discussing evidence behind PEG use. Not a randomised controlled trial.
Comparative study of percutaneous radiological gastrostomy (PRG) vs PEG in ALS patients. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
RCT comparing EuroQol vs SF-36 instruments in stroke patients. Not related to PEG vs NGT feeding.
Cross-sectional study examining relationships between oral health, dysphagia and undernutrition. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Multicentre randomised controlled trial comparing PEG vs nasogastric feeding in dysphagic stroke patients. Primary outcome included death/poor outcome at 6 months. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective observational study assessing safety of PEG. Not a randomised controlled trial comparing PEG vs NGT.
Review article analyzing vitamin D content in enteral nutrition formulas. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Retrospective study comparing pull-through vs push PEG techniques. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
Development and validation study of dysphagia screening questionnaire for Parkinson's disease. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Prospective audit comparing nasal loop technique vs PEG in dysphagic stroke patients. Not a randomised controlled trial.
Quality improvement report describing changes to PEG service. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
RCT validating residual volumes as marker for aspiration risk. While it includes both NGT and PEG patients, the intervention being tested is management of residual volumes, not PEG vs NGT comparison.
Case series describing enteral tube feeding in anorexia nervosa. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Retrospective review comparing PEG vs Stamm gastrostomy. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.

Prospective randomized trial comparing nasogastric tube vs percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy for enteral feeding. 90 patients enrolled (46 NGT, 44 PEG). Assessed complications, treatment failure, and patient preference. Meets selection criteria.

Randomised 28-day study comparing PEG vs nasogastric tube feeding in 40 patients with persisting neurological dysphagia. Main outcome was treatment failure (blocked/displaced tubes or refusal to continue). Meets all selection criteria.
Cross-sectional study investigating anemia prevalence and associations with nutritional status in hospitalized elderly. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Literature review discussing complications and controversies of PEG. Not a primary randomised controlled trial.
Meta-analysis comparing radiologic, endoscopic, and surgical gastrostomy. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
Selective literature review on malnutrition in hospital. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Cochrane systematic review update on enteral feeding methods in head and neck cancer. Only one small RCT met inclusion criteria. This is a review, not a primary RCT.
Nonrandomized retrospective analysis comparing push vs pull PEG techniques in head and neck cancer. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
Observational study analyzing incidence and predictors of dysphagia after stroke. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Case report of granular cell tumour of cervical oesophagus. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Observational study evaluating impact of nutrition therapy in dysphagia patients. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Prospective comparison of nutritional status in elderly stroke patients on long-term NG feeding vs oral controls. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Retrospective study investigating esophageal alterations in dysphagia patients using videofluoroscopy. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Review article on enteral feeding indications and limitations. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.

Randomized prospective clinical trial comparing PEG vs NG tube feeding in 23 patients with acute dysphagic stroke. Assessed nutritional status and treatment failure. Treatment failure occurred in 5/10 NG patients vs 0/10 PEG patients. Meets selection criteria.

Randomized trial comparing PEG tubes vs NGT in 33 head and neck cancer patients receiving (chemo)radiotherapy. Assessed nutritional outcomes, complications, patient satisfaction and cost. Meets selection criteria.
Prospective randomized trial comparing PEG vs surgical gastrostomy. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
Review article on gastroenteric tube feeding techniques and complications. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.

Randomised prospective study comparing gastrostomy tube feeding vs nasogastric tube feeding in 30 patients with acute dysphagic stroke. Assessed mortality, feed administration, nutritional state, and treatment failure. Meets all selection criteria.
Review article on parenteral and enteral nutrition therapy for intestinal failure in children. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT in adults.
Development and validation of Huntington's Disease Dysphagia Scale. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Cochrane systematic review on enteral tube feeding in ALS/MND. No RCTs were found. This is a review, not a primary RCT.
Review article on hospital malnutrition prevalence and identification. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Review article on enteral nutrition delivery techniques. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Prospective randomized trial comparing operative gastrostomy vs endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG). Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
ESPEN guidelines on artificial enteral nutrition/PEG. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Review article on diagnosis and nutritional management of dysphagia in stroke patients. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Retrospective comparative study of fluoroscopically guided, percutaneous endoscopic, and surgical gastrostomy. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
Cochrane systematic review on interventions for dysphagia and nutritional support in stroke. Includes meta-analysis of RCTs but is itself a review, not a primary RCT.
Prospective multicenter cohort study comparing PEG vs NGT in older people. Not a randomised controlled trial.
Retrospective study comparing functional dysphagia therapy with or without PEG feeding. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Population-based observational study on ventilation and enteral nutrition in ALS. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
CONSORT statement on reporting of randomised trials. Not a primary research study.
Sensory evaluation study of oral nutritional supplements. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Meta-analysis comparing early gastric vs post-pyloric feeding in critically ill patients. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
Cross-sectional study evaluating nutritional status and length of hospital stay. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Review article on enteral nutrition. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Review article on endoscopic percutaneous gastrostomy indications and care. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Systematic review and meta-analysis comparing gastric vs post-pyloric feeding. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
Case report of PVC-associated dysphagia. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Retrospective review comparing PEG vs NG tubes in head and neck carcinoma patients. Not a randomised controlled trial.
Descriptive analytic study assessing acceptability and outcomes of PEG placement from patient/caregiver perspectives. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Randomised controlled trial comparing looped NGT vs conventional adhesive dressing for securing NGT in stroke patients. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.
Double-blind randomized trial comparing whey protein vs casein enteral formula in stroke patients. Both groups received nasogastric feeding. Does not compare PEG vs NGT.

Prospective randomized controlled study investigating effect of PEG on gastroesophageal reflux in mechanically ventilated patients. Comparison is PEG vs non-PEG (continuing NGT), but population is ventilated patients with VAP, not specifically dysphagia patients. The primary outcome is GER reduction, not intervention failure. Borderline but excluded due to different primary focus.
Retrospective observational study on nutritional status and clinical outcomes in internal medicine wards. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Quasi-experimental study evaluating aspiration risk-reduction protocol. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
Technical description of percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy technique with case series. Not an RCT comparing PEG vs NGT.
